title: THE PLAYER 2 SAVE STAYS SHUT WHILE ITS WINDOW IS OPEN
why: Found by the code comb of 2026-10-07: the player 1 window greys out the save the player 2 window has open (v17.93), but only while it sits in a two player mode, and reloading the player 1 window drops the mode: player 1 could then load or erase the save player 2 was still playing and saving to. The player 2 window now leaves a mark every 2 seconds that it is open (taken off when it closes), and the save stays shut while the mark is fresh.
now: After a reload of player 1 window, player 2 save still shows IN USE BY PLAYER 2 while their window is open.
